construct: transform: scale(0) on a child part at the default axis value, scale(1) on the other — the mui.radio `checked` shape (scale(0) IS the library's hide mechanism for the selection dot)
why: The zero-scale matrix was outside the transform channel's bounded grammar AND the by-axis rescue was hard-scoped to border-*-style, so the whole channel refused and the dot inherited the CHECKED identity transform. The blind re-grade measured all 7 unchecked mui.radio cells drawing a filled inner dot — every unchecked radio read as SELECTED. A collapsed matrix is not a decoration: it means the node paints nothing, which the canvas expresses by not drawing the node.

canvas.note: the checked=unchecked cell draws no node for the part at all (a collapsed matrix paints nothing); the checked cell draws it
